query: What formal thresholds (standardized mean differences, KS tests, MSPE ratios) will trigger switching from propensity-score matching to entropy balancing, CEM, or synthetic control?

response.query: What formal thresholds (standardized mean differences, KS tests, MSPE ratios) will trigger switching from propensity-score matching to entropy balancing, CEM, or synthetic control?
response.answer: Switching from propensity-score matching to entropy balancing, CEM, or synthetic control typically occurs when standardized mean differences exceed 0.2, KS test p-values drop below 0.05, or MSPE ratios surpass 1.2.
